evals.prompt: Build the Collection toolbar for CoinsLite (repo at /Users/marius/Developer/coinslite, see docs/functional-spec.md section 7 and the shared UI package in packages/ui). It needs: a Filter control covering Item type, Country, Grade and Album (with counts); active filters shown so they can be removed one at a time or all at once; a search box; and a Display control for sort order and list/grid view. Filters and search must be reflected in the URL. Write the React/TSX components into the output directory only; do not modify the repo. Assume the components you need from packages/ui exist or note which shadcn components you would add.
evals.expected_output: TSX files for a toolbar, filter menu, filter chips and display menu in a compact, Linear-like arrangement using shadcn Popover/Command, with URL-backed state.
assertions: Filter and pickers use Popover + Command (cmdk) rather than Select/DropdownMenu lists
Active filters are chips with per-chip remove control
A clear-all control exists for filters
Filter/search state is read from and written to the URL
Chrome controls use compact 28px / 13px sizing (h-7 or text-[13px] or size="xs")
No oversized controls: no h-10 on Button or Input elements
Display control exposes sort order and list/grid view
All visible strings go through t() (no raw English labels in JSX)

evals.prompt: Build the Add Item dialog for CoinsLite (repo at /Users/marius/Developer/coinslite; read docs/functional-spec.md sections 5.1 and 5.4 and packages/ui). The dialog must let the user pick the Item type, enter a title, choose an Album (or create one inline), set Grade, Strike, Quantity, Purchase price, purchase date and source, Market value and notes, with the optional descriptive facts grouped so the basic form stays short. Submit with the keyboard too. Write the TSX into the output directory only; do not modify the repo. Strings may be t() keys.
evals.expected_output: A compact create dialog: small header, borderless title input, property pills row for structured attributes, collapsible optional group, footer with Cancel and primary action with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.
assertions: Dialog submits on Cmd/Ctrl+Enter
Album picker supports inline create of a new Album
Structured attributes are pills/pickers built on Popover+Command, not stacked Select boxes
Optional descriptive facts sit in a collapsible group
No large dialog title styling (text-lg/text-xl on DialogTitle)
Compact control sizing used (h-7/h-8, text-[13px], size xs/sm)
Keyboard hint (Kbd) shown on the primary action
All visible strings go through t()

evals.prompt: Build the Item detail screen for CoinsLite (repo at /Users/marius/Developer/coinslite; read docs/functional-spec.md section 5.7 and packages/ui). Show the front/back photos, every descriptive fact with a value, Grade with its scale, Strike, Quantity, Purchase price, Market value, purchase date and source, notes and Album, plus Metal value for gold/silver Items. Users must be able to change Album, Grade, Strike, Quantity and the prices without leaving the screen, and to edit, duplicate or delete the Item (delete needs confirmation). Write the TSX into the output directory only; do not modify the repo.
evals.expected_output: Content column with photos and facts plus a right properties panel of label/value rows where values are clickable pills that save immediately; delete via an alert dialog.
assertions: Has a right properties panel (border-l, fixed width ~280px)
Property rows pair a muted label with an editable value control
Values change in place via Popover+Command pickers (no page-level Save button)
Delete uses a confirmation (AlertDialog or ConfirmDialog)
Changes save immediately and offer undo via toast
Metal value is computed and shown for gold/silver
Compact sizing (h-7, text-[13px], size xs) used in chrome
All visible strings go through t()
